rule.break_rule: gap > 300 s between consecutive labels of the same day is a break and is excluded; a gap of exactly 300 s is kept
rule.gap_definition: difference of consecutive sorted labeled_at stamps within one calendar day (first 10 characters of the stamp); gaps never span midnight; identical stamps give a 0 s gap that is kept
rule.active_time_s: sum of the kept gaps (the first label of a day starts the clock)
rule.quantiles: numpy percentile, linear interpolation; IQR = q75 - q25
rule.overall_median: median of all kept gaps of the pool, pooled over days
rule.l_rand_seed_exclusion: L_rand rows that are seed rows (L_AL IDs stamped by L_rand on its first day, the E14 seed definition, lib/live_record.seed_and_added) carry stamps copied from L_AL when the random pool was created, not labelling events of the random session; they are excluded from L_rand throughput. L_AL uses all rows.

L_rand.seed_definition: seed = L_AL IDs that L_rand stamped on its first day (2026-05-01); added = remaining L_AL IDs
